method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.

scope: From the seat of the passport applicant and, for a child, the child and the people whose consent s 11 requires. The definition of a child (s 6(1)); parental responsibility (s 11(5)); consent of each person with parental responsibility or a court order (s 11(1)) and the exceptions (s 11(2)), with the special circumstances of Determination s 10; the citizen's entitlement, the approved form and the fee (s 7); the Minister's satisfaction of citizenship and identity (s 8); the mandatory refusal after a s 12 request (s 12(2)); the discretionary refusals after a s 13, 14 or 16 request or two losses in five years (ss 13(2), 14(2), 15, 16(2)); stale or withdrawn requests (s 19); a document already valid or suspended (s 17, Determination ss 15-16); refusal to process (s 19A); validity (s 20, Determination ss 17-19) and which Determination governs (Determination s 31); application and additional fees with indexation as an input (Fees Determination ss 5-7); waivers (Determination s 27(1)(a), (k), (l), s 28A); reviewable decisions (s 48) and the 28-day review period (s 49(2)). Not encoded: travel-related documents (ss 9-10), competent authorities and the grounds of requests (ss 12(1), 13(1), 14(1), 16(1), 18), cancellation, suspension and surrender (ss 22-26), offences (Part 4), information (ss 42-47), names (s 53), refunds (Determination s 28), notice (s 48A), the Tribunal (s 50), machinery (ss 51-58); the pre-2015 text of s 11 and the 2005 Determination (not deposited); fees before 2024.
seat: the passport applicant; for a child, the child and the people with parental responsibility whose consent s 11 requires
